name: Scootini Goosini
tagline: He didn't come in peace. He came with your pizza. And he's already leaving.
description: Scootini Goosini is half goose, half scooter and the worst courier in the city. He has your pizza and he is not coming back. $GOOSINI — a community memecoin on Solana.

hero.text: Thanks for your order. It was delicious.

about.title: Meet Goosini
text: Half goose, half scooter. Nobody ordered either half.
He accepts every order in the city. He delivers none of them.
He knows your address. He is not going there.
No tip needed. He already took the fries.

stop.title: Stop at the door

lines.hint: He rides by himself. Tap, click or press Space once to brake. Stop right at the orange door.
lines.good: Stopped at the door. Order eaten.

lines.overShort: The courier stopped {miss} m short of the door. Orders eaten at the door: {score}.

stop.shareText: My goose stopped at {score} doors and ate every order. He didn't come in peace. He came with your pizza. ${ticker}

howToBuy.title: Get a wallet
howToBuy.text: Install Phantom or Solflare from the official website or app store.

howToBuy.title: Get some SOL
howToBuy.text: Buy SOL on an exchange and send it to your wallet.

howToBuy.title: Open pump.fun
howToBuy.text: Connect your wallet and paste the $GOOSINI contract address.

howToBuy.title: Swap for $GOOSINI
howToBuy.text: Choose the amount and confirm the swap. Do not wait for the courier.
